style.text: Use indigo as the main color, with orange-red as the sole prominent accent at the bookmark tucked into the pages.
Concentrate detail at the bookmark, page edges, and fingertips and keep the surrounding area sparse.
Build forms with indigo lines of distinct weights and flat ink shapes over lightly fibrous off-white paper.

character.text: Feature an open book and a reader's hand, depicting the reader placing a bookmark to mark their place.

environment.text: Set the image in a reading table in a neighborhood library after rain, using only essential background detail.

narrative.text: Lead the eye from the indigo title at the top to the open pages, then settle on the orange-red bookmark.

instructions.text: Place the title at the top of the image in legible indigo lettering.
